receive_fathom_webhook.description: Receives and validates Fathom webhook payload sent directly from Fathom's webhook service. Extracts call_id, timestamp, meeting_title, summary, key_actions, and participants from the webhook data structure.

process_user_fathom_payload.description: Processes Fathom payload provided manually by a user (via chat, form, or copy-paste). Accepts JSON string and parses it into structured data with meeting_title, things_discussed, key_actions, and participants.

get_current_time.description: Gets the current date and time in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Use this to calculate due dates and reminder times.

calculate_future_time.description: Calculates a future time by adding minutes to a base time. Returns time in ISO format.

create_meeting_notes_canvas.description: Creates a structured meeting notes canvas in Slack with sections for meeting title, attendees, things discussed, and action items. Posts canvas to specified channel_id. Accepts JSON array strings for things_discussed and action_items.

channel_id.description: Slack channel ID where canvas will be posted

things_discussed.description: JSON array string of discussion points, e.g. '["Point 1", "Point 2"]'

action_items.description: JSON array string of action items, e.g. '[{"task_title": "Task 1", "owner_name": "John", "due_date": "2025-03-15"}]'

create_task_reminder.description: Creates task reminders for multiple users via email before a due date. Automatically adjusts reminder time to 2 minutes from now if calculated time is in the past. Sends scheduled direct messages with task details. Accepts comma-separated email addresses. Requires OAuth scopes: chat:write, users:read.email

reminder_advance_hours.description: Hours before due date to send reminder (auto-adjusts to 2 min if past)

send_scheduled_direct_message.description: Sends a scheduled direct message to a user by email address. Automatically adjusts to 2 minutes from now if scheduled time is in the past. Accepts scheduled_time in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). Requires OAuth scopes: chat:write, users:read.email

scheduled_time.description: Time to send in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)

get_user_id_from_email.description: Retrieves Slack user ID (e.g., U123ABC) from email address. Requires OAuth scope: users:read.email

get_user_by_email.description: Looks up a Slack user by email address and returns full user object with id, real_name, and profile details. Requires OAuth scope: users:read.email
